instruction: The QAM Stack landing page and the Quality Harness page were both updated on 2026-10-15, and the landing page now changes weekly. Update the two sitemaps to say so. In sitemap.xml, the entry for https://atvirokodosprendimai.github.io/qamstack/ gets lastmod 2026-10-15 and changefreq weekly. In qamstack/sitemap.xml, the entry for https://qamstack.dev/ gets lastmod 2026-10-15 and changefreq weekly, and the entry for https://qamstack.dev/quality-harness/ gets lastmod 2026-10-15 and keeps changefreq monthly. The entry for the site root, https://atvirokodosprendimai.github.io/, keeps its lastmod and changefreq, and every priority stays as it is. Change nothing else.
